passages.text: Grandma brings an old kite to our family picnic beside the lake. Her father showed her how to make it when she was a child. Now three generations—Grandma, Dad and me—repair its loose string together. The wind starts to blow, but the kite turns in circles near the ground. Dad holds it while Grandma checks the string, and I change the paper tail. On the next try, it rises above us, and we cheer together. I draw our family and the kite in my diary that evening.

parallelText.en: Grandma brings an old kite to our family picnic beside the lake.
parallelText.zh: 奶奶带了一只旧风筝来参加湖边家庭野餐。

parallelText.en: Her father showed her how to make it when she was a child.
parallelText.zh: 她小时候，她的父亲教过她怎样做这种风筝。

parallelText.en: Now three generations—Grandma, Dad and me—repair its loose string together.
parallelText.zh: 现在，奶奶、爸爸和我这三代人一起修整松动的风筝线。

parallelText.en: The wind starts to blow, but the kite turns in circles near the ground.
parallelText.zh: 风开始吹了，但风筝只在近地面转圈。

parallelText.en: Dad holds it while Grandma checks the string, and I change the paper tail.
parallelText.zh: 爸爸托着风筝，奶奶检查线，我调整纸尾巴。

parallelText.en: On the next try, it rises above us, and we cheer together.
parallelText.zh: 再试一次时，它升到了我们的头顶上方，大家一起欢呼。

parallelText.en: I draw our family and the kite in my diary that evening.
parallelText.zh: 当晚，我在日记里画下家人和风筝。

passages.text: During a visit to a desert town, our class stays inside the visitor centre. Outside, a sandstorm fills the air with dry sand, and we cannot see the bus clearly. For the next hour, nobody can take the planned outdoor walk. The guide asks for a solution to the problem of a bored class. We use our notebooks to make a picture story about the places we saw earlier. By the time the air is clear again, everyone has a page to share.

parallelText.en: During a visit to a desert town, our class stays inside the visitor centre.
parallelText.zh: 参观一个沙漠小镇时，我们班留在游客中心里。

parallelText.en: Outside, a sandstorm fills the air with dry sand, and we cannot see the bus clearly.
parallelText.zh: 外面，一场沙暴使空中满是干沙，我们看不清公交车。

parallelText.en: For the next hour, nobody can take the planned outdoor walk.
parallelText.zh: 接下来的一小时，谁都无法按计划外出步行参观。

parallelText.en: The guide asks for a solution to the problem of a bored class.
parallelText.zh: 导游请大家想个办法，解决全班等待时无聊的问题。

parallelText.en: We use our notebooks to make a picture story about the places we saw earlier.
parallelText.zh: 我们用笔记本把先前看过的地方画成一个图画故事。

parallelText.en: By the time the air is clear again, everyone has a page to share.
parallelText.zh: 等空气重新清晰时，每个人都有一页作品可以分享。
